api.line: API is Fastify 5 (migrated from Express 4, PR #412, api 3.0.0): middleware are plugins in apps/api/src/plugins/ (auth, cors, rate-limit, request-id, error-handler); handlers take (request, reply); requireAuth verifies Clerk JWTs, 401 token_expired / invalid_token.

Validation zod only; schemas in apps/api/src/schemas/, safeParse -> 400 invalid_body.

Keep connectRetryWindowMs >= 120_000 (RDS failover 90s). PgBouncer transaction mode: prepare:false, driver doesn't pass it to raw pool yet.
Invoice endpoint includes lineItems only with expand=lineItems; only open invoices can be overdue.
CLI: `acme login` device flow, token in keytar; `--bom` for CSV; ACME_API_URL; apiGet retries 502/503/504 (staging 502s ~40s on deploys).
Every table has org_id; every query must filter by req.auth.orgId. JSON camelCase (totalCents); convert SUM() DECIMAL strings to numbers.
Public rate limit: @fastify/rate-limit plugin, 100/min per IP counted in Redis, /healthz exempt.
Webhooks signed HMAC SHA-256 in X-Acme-Signature: t=<ts>,v1=<hex> over '<ts>.<raw body>' (webhooks/sign.ts).
Export CSV headers snake_case; amount_cents (was amountCents) per finance.
Request id plugin: x-request-id (or UUID) on every log as requestId and echoed on response; web doesn't send it, Sentry not tagged.
Search uses Postgres tsvector columns (drizzle/0031_clients_search.sql), not Elasticsearch; add no search service.

Drizzle: load relations explicitly via `with:` to avoid N+1; unfixed in routes/payments/list.ts, routes/clients/list.ts.
